about: Persona character registry spec. One per character, saved as numbered versions (v1, v2, ...). Your AI tool reads the latest version before every image so the character stays on-model. Fill in what you can; the identity sentence and two reference images matter most.
id: the character's slug, e.g. nova-reyes (set by Persona, never changes)

identity.sentence: ONE sentence describing the face, hair and signature detail. It is pasted word for word into every prompt.
identity.face: Face shape and features that never change
identity.body: Height and build, e.g. tall and slim
identity.signature_detail: The one thing people recognise instantly
never_change: traits the AI must never change, e.g. hair colour

world.home_city: Used by the 'Home city landmark' location preset
world.hobby: Used by the 'Doing their hobby' pose preset

references.url: https://... an approved image of the character

avoid: things this character should never be shown with
